title: Airy Crunchy Spanish Coconut Croquetas
description: A crunchy and floral Spanish dish featuring unsweetened coconut milk and long-fermentation-dough, formed into croquetas.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add olive oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough ferment for 2 hours in a warm place.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and fill with a spoonful of coconut milk mixture.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a croqueta and seal the edges.
Heat about 2-3 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the croquetas until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the croquetas on paper towels and serve hot.
